events.name: Bash
events.head: Check related tasks and pass.py blockers support

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read-only poll of Tantra accounts and centre reminder flag
events.input: $ set -a && . ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; K=$(grep -o '^[A-Z_]*=' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env | head -3); echo "$K"; V=$(grep -E '^(TANTRA_API_KEY|TANTRA_KEY)=' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); curl -s -H "x-api-key: $V" "https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1/accounts?limit=500" | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Retry read-only poll with lenient JSON parsing

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect accounts paging and centre reminder settings
events.input: $ V=$(grep -E '^TANTRA_API_KEY=' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'"'"); for q in "" "?limit=100"; do curl -s -H "x-api-key: $V" "https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1/accounts$q" | python3 -c "
